findings.consequence: A genuine qualification receipt for the same spec and runtime but different graph/role inputs or source manifest can satisfy the adapter assertions if root fails to perform that comparison externally. Actual fit input hashing does not establish that the exact inputs and source were qualified.
findings.observation: The admission validates top-level prepared_graph/TRAIN/validation hashes. Its root_qualification object is checked only for passed, spec hash, runtime binding, receipt-hash syntax and named checks. The spec indirectly binds the protocol hash, but qualification source-manifest and graph/role identities are neither required nor compared with the full admission.
findings.required_before_full_admission: Root must authenticate the receipt and explicitly compare its source-manifest/graph/TRAIN/validation identities with the full admission, preserving that result. Prefer asserting these identities inside root_qualification and comparing them in validate_admission in a separately resealed revision.
findings.title: Full qualification is not structurally bound to the admitted inputs

findings.consequence: The implementation does not guarantee the documented catchable-failure behavior for a device error surfaced at interval synchronization. If no later operation raises, the terminal can claim success despite a recorded device failure.
findings.observation: At the end of a charged interval, synchronize exceptions are converted into synchronization_error text and are not re-raised. Success finalization does not inspect the recorded errors before emitting status=success.
findings.required_before_accepting_success: Propagate end-of-interval synchronization errors when no prior exception is active, preserving both errors when needed; alternatively root must reject every attempt with any non-null synchronization_error and issue failed closure. Preserve the original sealed packet.
findings.title: A CUDA synchronization failure can remain compatible with a success terminal

remaining_execution_and_admission_blocke: Genuine current graph-init closure and scientific decision/backend/role freeze remain root prerequisites; the template is deliberately inadmissible.
No runtime/scientific receipt was inspected or generated by this review. Torch/PyG compatibility and numerical correctness are unresolved.

Actual module counts, selection/ties/epoch0, restored model+Adam state, both Photo stages, finite derivatives and exact role custody require root qualification of the fitter. The prepared test_ports hooks do not exercise the new fitting loop.
vmap needs supported forward/backward, member isolation, distinct training dropout and output/gradient/two-step-Adam equivalence in the admitted runtime. An unsupported skip is not a pass.
MIMO needs numerical complete-row/compact-label/inference repetition/summed-head-gradient checks in the admitted runtime.

The runtime fingerprint binds versions, GAT source text and selected environment/device flags. It is not a complete installed runtime source/wheel/binary inventory and does not authenticate already-loaded Python bodies; root must separately preserve runtime provenance and fresh-process source custody.

Root must supervise wall caps, process/storage loss, genuine receipt authenticity, all outer and failed-attempt costs, and separate report admission. Every fitter output remains report_eligible=false.

reviewed_semantics.source_observation: Before global activation, selected local model and Adam dictionaries are loaded and checked tensor/metadata-exact, then local validation NLL is re-evaluated. Inactive global parameters and absent Adam slots are included in state dictionaries. Stage flags are restored explicitly.

Local and global loops have eligible epoch0 and exactly 200/1000 positive-epoch updates in full mode. The global selector is reset after handoff, and a global-only final checkpoint is enforced. Training RNG continues through the handoff as disclosed.

Finite full member logits and validation NLL are checked; common-logit NLL is the sole primary selector. Strict < retains earliest exact ties. Squirrel stops when epoch-best_epoch reaches 250. Secondary probability pooling is declared from selected logits and never participates in selection.

Each CPU generator draw forms four separate TRAIN-position permutations; every position appears once per slot per update. Nodes and labels are indexed from those exact compact positions. [tuple,slot,13,feature] is permuted to [tuple,13,slot,feature] before slot-feature flattening, preserving complete token rows and slot order.

Inference repeats each complete [13,F] target row in all four feature slots. Outputs reshape to [tuple,4,5] for training and [4,node,5] for inference. Flattened CE multiplied by four equals mean-over-tuples of the sum of matching-head CE. This retains the disclosed loss scale rather than mean-head normalization.

The same-width independent arm uses private native member parameters but one common-epoch pooled selector and mean-member CE. The documented one-quarter private gradient scale and Adam epsilon caveat are required scientific adaptations; it is not an exact independently selected native ensemble reproduction.

Manifest hash admission precedes scientific imports; every listed source file hash/size is checked. Local namesakes are rejected by origin. Actual prepared graph and compact role content identities are computed and compared with admission before updates. Unique disjoint roles and retained shapes/devices/classes are checked. No final-label parameter exists.

Independent arithmetic agrees with the declared complete counts, and next legal widths exceed each cap. Actual module counts are checked after construction, before role binding/selection. This is source algebra, not constructed-module evidence.

scope: Source/text/AST/integer metadata only; no execution of packet modules, scientific imports, data, labels, arrays, checkpoints, SSH or GPU.
